name: Anata ga Tanetsuke Shita no wa Ai Suru Tsuma Desu ka? ~Sukebe na Futago no Ane ga Kodane o Motomete Koshi o Furu~
original_name: あなたが種付けしたのは愛する妻ですか？～スケベな双子の姉が子種を求めて腰を振る～
source:
My wife, Shino, greets me warmly whenever I return home.
We've grown accustomed to married life, and she's started talking about wanting to have children.
When I excitedly expressed my desire for both of us, Shino smiled shyly but with joy.
So that night, I must have done it with my beloved wife.
There's no way I'd have done it with my sister-in-law, who happened to be visiting.
"You're way too early, trying to tell us apart..."
translation:
每次回家，妻子Shino都会热情地迎接我。
我们逐渐习惯了婚后生活，她也开始提起想要孩子。
我兴奋地表达了两人一起生儿育女的愿望，Shino害羞又开心地笑了。
所以，那晚我肯定是和心爱的妻子做了……
我绝不可能和恰巧来访的小姨子做那种事。
“你分辨我们也太早了吧……”
